newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIAN OFFICIAL BEATEN UP AHEAD OF SPECIAL MEETING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIAN OFFICIAL BEATEN UP AHEAD OF SPECIAL MEETING.

text.p: The general secretary of the Bulgarian Football Union and former head coach Ivan Vutsov has been beaten up in front of his house ahead of an extraordinary congress of the union.
Vutsov, 56, was attacked by three young men on Friday night but neighbours forced them to flee. "They did not even say a word and did not try to rob me," Vutsov was quoted as saying.

Vutsov, who was allowed home after hospital treatment, is one of the main organisers of the union's December 20 congress which is expected to replace leading figures after some clubs accused them of mismanagement.
